messages:
Sam Customer: hey @alice our invoice summarization started returning 'TOTAL: 0' for some invoices right after today's deploy. Happens when the prompt template ends with a trailing period. Repro below — very high priority from our billing team :eyes:

Alice Support: sorry about that, can you paste the exact request body + `request_id`? tagging @leo. Also, did this affect all customers or just a few?

Sam Customer: here's a minimal repro we ran against the hosted API (request_id: req_8f3a):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd/galaxy-1.3","prompt":"Summarize invoice lines and produce TOTAL: {total}.","max_tokens":30}'

Response (incorrect):
{"id":"res_123","text":"...
TOTAL: 0
"}

Alice Support: thanks — escalated to ML and SRE. Any chance it worked before the deploy? /cc @jess

Leo ML: investigating. Can you try pinning the model to `rwd/galaxy-1.2.9` and retry? We rolled `rwd/galaxy-1.3` canary at ~10:05am today.

deploy-bot: canary deploy rwd/galaxy-1.3 @ 1962000000 - status: successful :white_check_mark:

Sam Customer: pinned to 1.2.9 and the issue disappears — totals back to expected. So this looks like a regression in 1.3.

Leo ML: initial hypothesis: tokenizer/byte-pair-change in 1.3 altered the token boundary when a prompt ends with '.' which breaks our prompt-template number-extraction regex. Will write a unit test that mirrors the customer's template. :mag:

Jess SRE: any errors or latency anomalies in their logs? or just wrong output?

Sam Customer: no API 5xxs, latency normal. Just semantic output change that affects downstream parsing.

Alice Support: we have two immediate mitigations: rollback canary to 1.2.9 for production traffic, or ship a customer-side template tweak (strip trailing punctuation) as a stopgap. @rachel do you want the rollback? :thinking:

Rachel PM: rollback the canary ASAP and prioritize a 1.3 patch that normalizes prompt trailing punctuation and adds a compatibility test. Notify affected customers. :loudspeaker: :pray:

Leo ML: agree. I'll prepare a minimal patch to normalize/truncate trailing punctuation before running the regex extractor and add unit tests that include '.' and '...' edgecases. ETA ~2h.

Jess SRE: initiating rollback for us-west-2 canary now.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated: rwd/galaxy-1.3 -> rwd/galaxy-1.2.9 (canary, us-west-2).

Sam Customer: appreciate the quick response. I'll confirm once our nightly job runs and report back. :thumbsup:
